description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EntityFunction' for entity functions in the OFBiz framework, including specific implementations for functions like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, and LOWER, along with utility methods for creating and handling these functions.

classes.name: EntityFunction
classes.description: Abstract base class for entity functions with nested and single value implementations, supporting SQL function operations like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER.

classes.name: EntityFunction.LENGTH
classes.description: Implementation of LENGTH function returning the length of a string or value.

classes.name: EntityFunction.TRIM
classes.description: Implementation of TRIM function removing whitespace from a string.

classes.name: EntityFunction.UPPER
classes.description: Implementation of UPPER function converting a string to uppercase.

classes.name: EntityFunction.LOWER
classes.description: Implementation of LOWER function converting a string to lowercase.

classes.name: EntityFunction.EntityFunctionSingle
classes.description: Abstract class for entity functions with a single value.

classes.name: EntityFunction.EntityFunctionNested
classes.description: Abstract class for nested entity functions.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Creates a LENGTH entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Creates a TRIM entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Creates an UPPER entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Creates a LOWER entity function for a nested or direct value.
